QUOTE: The wording is graded, not fixed. The module has a test that a note claiming certainty must have earned it. It also says that the definitive note is kept only when nothing unread could have matched.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the wording is graded and must be earned, but it never states that the strong wording is earned per call by querying which corpora weren't read, as opposed to being tied to a result shape. Its table keys outcomes to result shapes (single token, multi-token, and so on).
